prompts.text: # Build: pass-all (Urgent profile) Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice), correcting theme-veto-pass (PR #262, branch claude/theme-veto-pass): "It's not supposed to be 30 minutes for theme changes. Narrow scopes (tokens.theme etc.)…
prompts.output: Yo boss, it's done. A pass now means everything: `axf pass grant 30` lets every command through for 30 minutes, not just theme changes. It's on `claude/theme-veto-pass` (fast-forward), so PR #262 carries it, and I left a comment on the PR saying so. **What changed** - **Scope `all` is the default.*…
